newsitem.title: USA: Hawaiian Airlines offerings raise $39 mln.
newsitem.headline: Hawaiian Airlines offerings raise $39 mln.

text.p: Hawaiian Airlines Inc said Sunday a shareholder rights offering and an investor offering were fully subscribed, collectively raising more than $39 million in new capital.

In August, the company registered a total of 12.1 million new shares of common stock for sale in the rights and investor offerings. All 12.1 million shares were purchased at the subscription price of $3.25 per share, generating the offerings' maximum possible gross proceeds of $39.3 million.
Including new shares sold in the rights and investor offerings, there are now a total of 38.5 million shares of Hawaiian Airlines Inc common stock outstanding, the airline said in a press release.
